summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Super Admin Panel and Enhanced Payroll Earnings features. All 17 backend API tests pass. All frontend UI elements verified working.

issues: Non-super-admin users can directly navigate to /admin URL (though API correctly returns 403). Ideally, frontend should redirect unauthorized users away from this route.
design_issues.note: Not a security issue - backend correctly blocks data access, just a UX polish item

Super Admin: GET /api/superadmin/groups returns all 24 groups with member_count and disabled_features
Super Admin: PUT /api/superadmin/groups/{id}/features toggles features on/off for a group
Super Admin: Invalid feature names rejected with 400 error
Super Admin: GET /api/superadmin/users returns all 55 users with group_name and is_banned status
Super Admin: Users can be filtered by group_id query parameter
Super Admin: PUT /api/superadmin/users/{id}/ban successfully bans/unbans a user
Super Admin: Banned user gets 403 on login attempt
Super Admin: Unbanned user can login again
Super Admin: Non-super-admin user gets 403 on all /api/superadmin/* endpoints
Super Admin: Employee user gets 403 on all /api/superadmin/* endpoints
Super Admin: Login response includes is_super_admin: true for super admin
Super Admin: Login response has is_super_admin: false for regular admin
Super Admin: GET /auth/me returns is_super_admin field
Super Admin: Frontend nav item 'Super Admin' only visible for super admin user
Super Admin: Frontend nav item hidden for regular admin user

Super Admin: Frontend Groups tab shows 24 group cards with 240 feature toggles
Super Admin: Frontend Users tab shows table with 55 ban buttons, search input, group filter dropdown
Payroll: GET /api/payroll/earnings returns per-employee earnings with akkord_earnings, hourly_earnings, total_earnings

Payroll: Frontend Earnings tab visible with Employees, Payroll Runs, Earnings tabs

Payroll: Frontend shows 'No work logged for [Month] [Year]' when no data
